title: R3.0E Capability Ledger
note: Defines each capability the R3.0E phase of the Integrated Delivery Train may eventually enable, its kind, and the earliest checkpoint at which it may be unlocked. A capability being DEFINED here does NOT mean it is ENABLED. Enablement is governed by governance/r3.0e/state.json (enabledCapabilities). E0 only defines the universe; no production capability is enabled at E0.

contract_foundation_present.description: R3.0E E1 contracts present under contracts/r3.0e/ (Experiment / Outcome / Control Variables / Case Timeline / follow-up linkage). NON-PRODUCTION at E1: no rendererAdapter, no runtime consumer, no algorithm.

governance_bootstrap_present.description: R3.0E Integrated Delivery Governance scaffold present: schema, state, capabilities, checkpoint-manifest schema, and integration with the train-level validators.

experiment_store_present.description: Renderer module backed by a SEPARATE versioned IndexedDB namespace storing Experiment objects (experimentId / sourceCaseId / hypothesisId / recommendationId / targetMetric / baselineValue / expectedDirection / expectedMagnitudeRange / setupChange / driverInstruction / controlVariables / validationPlan / stopConditions / status / followUpCaseIds / outcome). status enum: draft/planned/applied/completed/abandoned/invalid. MUST include schemaVersion, future-version fail-closed, atomicity, orphan handling and rollback. MUST NOT extend the frozen R3.0B case-record schema.

outcome_classifier_present.description: Outcome classifier comparing expected vs observed direction + magnitude + side-effects + driver-feedback + data-quality + comparability. Output enum: confirmed / partially_confirmed / contradicted / inconclusive / invalid_comparison. Missing control variables → inconclusive_due_to_confounders. NO auto-mutation of model / tyre-calib / preset; local evidence history only.

case_timeline_present.description: Case Timeline rendering: baseline → recommendation → applied setup → follow-up → outcome. Bidirectional parent ↔ follow-up linkage. Deleted parent case → follow-up flagged as orphan, not silently broken.

feature_registry_active.description: Feature Registry registers the R3.0E feature IDs (experiment_loop / case_timeline — to be named exactly at E5 authorization time) as available, attaching their rendererAdapter. Only valid at E5.
